deliberateDepartures: The explicit common light palette replaces the reference palette while retaining semantic roles.
Geometry, card placement and connector routing adapt to the five target aspect ratios; reference Pattern/Text/export content is omitted because it is unrelated to the briefs.
Kit primitives are simplified and resized by hand. Rounded cards have no perimeter outlines, while clocks, checks and chair legs retain necessary detail strokes.
Available-seat emphasis appears in both B and C text badges to preserve the required equal selection eligibility.
Essential Japanese labels use 16–22 CSS px, and supporting labels use 12–14 CSS px to fit the declared targets; the scheme reference label size of 32 units is adapted to target dimensions.

font.limitations: Font is not embedded. Rendering depends on the consuming environment; fallback and missing glyph behavior there is unverified. No browser rendering or visual acceptance has been claimed.

limitations: Outputs are the initial attempt artifacts. XML structure and exact visible labels were checked. Target-size output rendering could not be completed: CairoSVG is unavailable and ImageMagick requires an unavailable rsvg-convert delegate. No packages or browsers were installed or launched, and no visual acceptance is claimed.
